failure_injection_evidence.caught_inner_fault_behavior: Inner nested _arm_rig_transaction catches BaseException, monotonically marks outer_tx.mark_rollback_only(reason), and re-raises. When outer caller catches the exception and attempts normal with-block exit, outer commit gate rejects commit before COMMITTING and triggers full outer rollback.
failure_injection_evidence.multi_level_nested_fault_behavior: Exception raised in 3rd-level nested transaction and caught by 2nd-level nested transaction marks the shared outer_tx rollback_only and forces outermost rollback.
failure_injection_evidence.subsequent_nested_entry_rejection: Once outer_tx.rollback_only is True, any subsequent nested _arm_rig_transaction on the same Armature is rejected at admission before yielding, preserving the first failure reason.
failure_injection_evidence.uncaught_inner_fault_behavior: Uncaught inner exception marks outer_tx.rollback_only = True and propagates directly into outer except block, executing exactly one rollback and re-raising the original business exception.
